warnings: The matching window ends 11 days before the decision date (2026-11-02); refetch POWER data closer to the decision.
The most recent days come from POWER's near-real-time products, not the long-term reanalysis; the response header lists these sources: MERRA2, GEOSIT, SRB, SYN1DEG, FLASHFLUX, POWER.
Look-alike years are drawn from Boro seasons 1999-2026 only: POWER humidity, temperature and rain series shift in 1997, so earlier years are not comparable.

Rainfall is not used for matching at this site: POWER's rain series here has an unrealistic jump from 2015, so matching uses temperature and humidity only. POWER's soil wetness here follows the same jump, so it is not shown either.
Backtest: No demonstrable skill: MSE skill score -0.148 against the plain average over 24 Boro seasons (2001–2024), permutation p = 0.528. The analog years are shown as historical examples only.
The extreme-day thresholds (35 °C, 50 mm) are working values, not yet confirmed by the team's science translator.
The crop rule table is an unreviewed draft (drafted with AI assistance from cited sources) and has not yet been checked by the team's science translator.
